description: The gate only guards writes. It never blocks a read. Guardrail files cannot be changed, except in a session a person switched to admin mode (admin_locked_paths stay closed there too); a session that holds a task writes inside the task folder only; dangerous terminal commands are denied or need a person to confirm.

why.en: it writes, deletes or moves one
it writes, deletes or changes the rights of one
it deletes or rewrites one with find
why.zh: 用 find 删除或改写

why.en: it overwrites or rewrites one with git
why.zh: 用 git 覆盖或改写

why.en: it rewrites one with an inline script
it recursively deletes the root, the home folder or the current folder
why.zh: 递归删除根目录、家目录或当前目录

why.en: it recursively force-deletes the root, the home folder or every file
why.zh: 递归强制删除根目录、家目录或所有文件

why.en: it hands a download straight to a shell or an interpreter to run
why.zh: 把下载的内容直接交给 shell 或解释器执行

why.en: it formats a disk or writes to a disk device directly
why.zh: 格式化磁盘或直接写磁盘设备

why.en: it changes rights recursively, or deletes containers, clusters or infrastructure
why.zh: 会递归改权限，或删除容器、集群、基础设施

why.en: only the user may run these, in their own terminal: approving a plan (task approve-plan), approving a write-back (task approve-promote), recovering a promote that failed halfway (task recover), giving more checks or waiving them (task review extend, task review waive), pausing and resuming a task (task pause, task resume), switching autorun on (task autorun on), approving a git command (approve-command), switching admin mode on (admin on). Tell the user to run the command; do not run it yourself
why.zh: 批准计划（task approve-plan）、批准回写（task approve-promote）、恢复中途出错的 promote（task recover）、再给检查次数或放行（task review extend、task review waive）、搁置和恢复任务（task pause、task resume）、开 autorun（task autorun on）、批准 git 命令（approve-command）、开 admin 模式（admin on）只能由用户在自己的终端里运行。告诉用户运行这条命令，不要自己运行

why.en: it rewrites or drops git history, branches or changes that are not committed
why.zh: 会改写或丢弃 git 历史、分支或未提交的改动
